standard_prerequisites.name: The flatness of the module extended by zero from an open, and the flatness of colimits of flat modules

standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the direct sum of those extended modules is flat.

core_obligations: Define the maps: for every open and every section of the module over it, the adjoint of the corresponding map of the structure sheaf on that open gives a map from the module extended by zero into the given module (proof lines 2868-2871)
Surjectivity: the direct sum of all these maps is surjective, because every section of the module over every open is represented by one of the summands (proof lines 2872-2878)
Flatness: the source is a direct sum of modules extended by zero from opens, hence flat by the flatness of those and of colimits, which gives the second assertion (proof lines 2878-2879)
proof_roadmap: 对每个开集 U 与 s ∈ F(U)，取 O_U → F|_U, 1 ↦ s 的伴随，得 j_{U!}O_U → F 的映射。
⊕_{(U,s)} j_{U!}O_U → F 显然满（每个截面都在其中），而每个 j_{U!}O_U 平坦、直和也平坦（本章两引理），故 F 是平坦模的商。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every module is a quotient of a direct sum of modules extended by zero from opens, and hence a quotient of a flat module (author lemma at source lines 2855-2864, label lemma-module-quotient-flat). The proof (source lines 2866-2880) builds one map from the module extended by zero on an open into the given module for every section over that open by adjunction, observes that the direct sum of all of them is surjective, and concludes flatness of the source from the flatness of the extended modules and of direct sums (proof lines 2868-2879). The adjunction construction and the flatness check are the content. H2.
